_note: Manual edits applied every build. `remove` drops a player from every output before the weekly re-seed (out for the season, retired). `set` pins a player's PUBLISHED Half PPR 10-team value after the re-seed, so the number written here is the number that appears; the other scoring/league-size formats derive from it. Names must match the sheet (suffix-insensitive); an unknown name stops the build. Edit, commit, and the workflow rebuilds within the hour.
